description: Na₃GdI₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six I¹⁻ atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaI₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent GdI₆ octahedra, and edges with five NaI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 5°. There are a spread of Na-I bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.25 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six I¹⁻ atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent GdI₆ octahedra, corners with four NaI₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent GdI₆ octahedra, and edges with four NaI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of Na-I bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.26 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six I¹⁻ atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaI₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent GdI₆ octahedra, and edges with five NaI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 5°. There are two shorter (3.21 Å) and four longer (3.22 Å) Na-I bond lengths. Gd³⁺ is bonded to six I¹⁻ atoms to form GdI₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaI₆ octahedra and edges with eight NaI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (3.07 Å) and four longer (3.08 Å) Gd-I bond lengths. There are three inequivalent I¹⁻ sites. In the first I¹⁻ site, I¹⁻ is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Gd³⁺ atom. In the second I¹⁻ site, I¹⁻ is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Gd³⁺ atom. In the third I¹⁻ site, I¹⁻ is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Gd³⁺ atom.
